head: Tromsø northern lights app made by local aurora guides
dek: Guide To Tromsø is an iPhone and iPad app for the northern lights in Tromsø, Norway, made by local aurora guides: it shows live aurora data, a cloud map, recent sightings from other users and viewing spots. It costs 49 cents once, with no subscription, and was #96 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: The aurora data covers the Kp index, Bz and solar wind. Besides viewing spots, the app lists local restaurants, tours and events. Version 2.0.3 from 11 November added a layers menu in its Live Sky view, a loading sign for clouds, rain and radar, and a softer colour theme for the home screen widgets. The app came out on 24 September and has no ratings yet.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, 49 cents
means: If you're planning a trip to Tromsø to see the northern lights, this app puts the aurora forecast, cloud cover and places to watch from in one place for less than a dollar.
todo: Search for Guide To Tromsø in the App Store; it needs iOS 16.4 or later.
thumb_words: TROMSØ AURORA APP BY LOCAL GUIDES
